scripts.build: tsc --build packages/core packages/db packages/adapters packages/agent packages/api packages/worker
scripts.bootstrap: npm run infra:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,dash -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run -w @kyc/api dev" "npm run -w @kyc/worker dev" "npm run -w @kyc/dashboard dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --dry packages/core packages/db packages/adapters packages/agent packages/api packages/worker
